speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have right groin pain and abnormal leg positioning after a rear-end collision; have you noticed any bruising, swelling, or numbness in your leg or foot? Also, was your leg forcibly positioned by an impact or did it move involuntarily on your own?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Posterior Hip Dislocation.

The mechanism of injury (rear-end collision with the back car) and your immediate onset of pain in the right groin and knee are highly suggestive of a hip dislocation. Can you describe the position of your right leg now? Is it shortened and rotated inward, or is it pointing outward?
